rationale: For each bus, the required reactive power (Q_req) to reach the target voltage was calculated as Q_req = (V_target - V_base) / sensitivity. This value was then clipped by the aggregate EV inverter capability (Q_max) at that bus, where Q_max is the sum of sqrt(S^2 - P^2) for all EVs on the bus. The final dispatched reactive power (q_dispatch_kvar) is min(Q_req, Q_max). The corrected voltage was then calculated as V_corrected = V_base + q_dispatch_kvar * sensitivity. The total_abs_q_kvar is the sum of the absolute values of the dispatched reactive power for all buses.
